original language: Ilahi Babima Redashte Balaa Jo Bimar ho Jald Paawe Shifa
translation: O my Lord grant us protection from Calamities and those who are unwell grant them recovery.

original language:
Ilahi Baraae Imame Zamaan, 
Hame Hawle Mahshar se de tu Amaan
translation: O Lord by the sake of Imam Zamaan, grant us protection on the day of Judgement

original language: Qayamat me Mashoor raho Baa Ali, Uthe Kabr se Kehke hum Ya Ali
translation: We pray to be with Imam Ali (AS) on the day of Judgement, and when we come out of our graves, we come out saying Ya Ali.

original language: Ai Pancha Wa Naw Mil Chahardahatan, Ahmad Wa Ali, Zahra Wa Hassan
translation: O the five Panjatan and the nine Imams making Fourteen Masumeen(AS), Ahmad, Ali, Zahra and Hassan

original language: Shabbir se le ta Imam Zamaan. Eka ek pe sada. Salawat paro, Salaawat
translation: From Shabbir to Imam Zaman(AF), blessings on each one of you and Recite Salawat on them.

original language: Salawaat o Salaam Ya Imame Zamaan, Farmao Zuhur Ya Imam Zamaan, Salawaat
translation: Salawat and Salaam, O Imam e Zaman, please reappear, O Imam Zaman, Salawat on you.
